dedupe_keys.name: deeplynx nexus formerly deep lynx digital engineering data warehouse idaho national laboratory

description: DeepLynx Nexus is the current form of Deep Lynx, an open-source data warehouse from Idaho National Laboratory for digital engineering and digital twin projects, in which design, sensor and model data about a facility are stored and linked. The README read on 2026-09-26 names the project DeepLynx Nexus, gives setup on the .NET 10 SDK with a PostgreSQL database run natively or through Docker Compose, and describes an optional DeepLynx Insight service that connects to language and embedding model endpoints. Coverage is generic, with no country or plant scope, and the repository gives INL staff and external users separate routes for bug reports. The code is free under the MIT licence held by Battelle Energy Alliance; formats and access are the GitHub source, Docker files and environment samples. Caveats: the rename brought a new technology stack, so older papers describing Deep Lynx may not match the current code, a repository tag is named Archived, and the README gives no sample data set. Simulation uses are a digital twin backbone that holds plant data and model outputs together so physics codes and risk models can be run against a current picture of the plant. Related records: platform-moose-multiphysics-framework is another INL simulation platform, and model-raven is the laboratory's risk and uncertainty framework.
